text:
Rhea (People Ops): FYI we're launching a consolidated handbook patch next Mon 09:00 PT covering: updated remote/home-office stipend caps, a short performance-cycle timing tweak (no change to ratings), and a mandatory 6-min compliance micro-cert for all managers. Please flag anything blocking publish. :loudspeaker:

Sam (HRIS): Will the HRIS need new fields? Recommend `handbook_version` + `ack_required` flags. I can push exports for manager teams.

Nikhil (Payroll): Need to know effective pay period for stipend changes and CSV headers for import. Avoid mid-cycle changes if possible.

Rhea (People Ops): Effective the first full pay period after publish. We'll not do retro. CSV example below — include ack_version so payroll can filter historical acks.

```
# stipend_ack_export.csv
employee_id,full_name,email,region,employment_type,stipend_amount,paid_via,ack_version,ack_ts,notes
```

Elsa (Legal): For EU/UK contractors we must not imply benefit eligibility. I'll add a short contractor clause and a VAT/tax pointer.

Marta (EMEA): Translations will take ~4 business days for the snippets. Recommend publish master with a "localized addendum forthcoming" banner.

Rhea (People Ops): Agreed. We'll publish master copy and add region addenda as they land. Manager micro-cert due 2 weeks after publish. Managers will get a 1-page checklist and an auto DM with nudges.

notif-bot: Scheduling: DMs to managers on publish; nudges at day 3 and day 10. Use `/notif-bot export-acks --since 2026-08-01 --format csv` to pull ack data.

Nikhil (Payroll): I'll validate CSV mapping by Friday if comp posts country table tomorrow. Please include `manager_override` for exceptions.

Rhea (People Ops): Will do. Action items: (1) publish master Mon 09:00 PT, (2) legal adds contractor clause, (3) comp posts country tax table, (4) payroll validates CSV by Fri, (5) HRIS exposes exports and dashboard. Any urgent blockers?

Elsa (Legal): No blockers; will post language by EOD.

Marta (EMEA): No blockers from EMEA; we'll start translations as soon as copy is final.

Sam (HRIS): I'll add `handbook_version` and `ack_required` today and wire the export to the reporting dashboard.

Rhea (People Ops): Thanks — I'll post the prod link and manager TL;DR after publish. :white_check_mark:
